en.t: In any case, he could not afford to move slowly.
He steeled himself and raised his head.

units.source_text: 一片阴郁、带红色的沙子，沿着沙坡的起伏，落下了慵懒的长长影子，

en.t: A stretch of gloomy, reddish sand cast long, languid shadows along the undulations of the dune,

units.source_text: 从影子里流出的飞沙之膜，一个接一个地又被吸进别的影子去了。

en.t: and the veils of drifting sand flowing out of the shadows were drawn, one after another, into other shadows.

units.source_text: 靠着这飞沙之膜，能巧妙地躲过瞭望哨的发现吧？

en.t: With those veils of flying sand, perhaps he could cleverly avoid being spotted by the lookout.

units.source_text: ……他想确认一下逆光的效果，回头一看，男人禁不住瞠目结舌。

en.t: ... Wanting to check the effect of the backlight, he looked back, and the man could not help staring in astonishment.

units.source_text: 西沉的太阳裹上一层蜡笔的颜色，周围泛起乳白色的烟雾，

en.t: The sinking sun was wrapped in a crayon-like color, and a milky-white haze rose around it,

units.source_text: 看来不仅仅是飞沙的缘故。

en.t: so it seemed that drifting sand was not the only cause.

units.source_text: 忽然，它们被吹散，被驱除，

en.t: Suddenly they were blown apart and driven away,

units.source_text: 薄雾到底还是不间断地从地面上涌了出来。

en.t: yet the thin mist still kept welling up from the ground without pause.

units.source_text: 此消彼长，那边刚被赶走，这边又露出了脸……

en.t: As one patch faded another grew; no sooner was it chased away over there than it showed its face again over here...

units.source_text: 以洞穴里的经验，他很了解沙子会回潮，

en.t: From his experience in the pit, he knew very well that sand could regain moisture,

units.source_text: 但没想到竟会如此厉害……

en.t: but he had never imagined it would be this intense...

units.source_text: 那情景简直是灭火以后的痕迹……

en.t: The scene was just like the traces left after a fire had been put out...

units.source_text: 不用说，因逆光的关系，淡淡的薄雾终于到了显眼的程度，

en.t: Needless to say, because of the backlight, the faint mist had finally become conspicuous enough,

units.source_text: 总算能蒙蔽监视人的眼睛，它成了最好的迷彩。

en.t: and at last it could deceive the watchers' eyes, becoming the best camouflage.
